# ForgottenDebugOutput

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `ForgottenDebugOutputInspection`

Dumping, tracing and profiler helpers (`var_dump()`, `print_r()`,
framework dumpers, Xdebug functions, …) are typically added while debugging
and forgotten afterwards. Flag their calls unless the context shows the
output is intentional.

## Example

Effective list = defaults + `audit_dump` + `\Acme\Tracer::dump` +
`\Acme\Probe::dump` (`migratedIntoUserSpace = false`).

```php{15,16,19,20,21,23,24,25,34}
<?php
namespace Acme;

use function var_dump;

class Tracer { public static function dump($v) {} }
class Probe  { public function dump($v) {} }
class Quiet  { public function dump($v) {} }

function audit_dump($v) {
    print_r($v);
}

function work($order, Probe $probe, Quiet $quiet) {
    var_dump($order, $probe);
    \print_r($order);
    $text = print_r($order, true);
    echo var_export($order, true);
    var_export($order);
    error_log('order seen', 3, '/var/log/app.log');
    debug_print_backtrace();
    phpinfo(INFO_GENERAL);
    audit_dump($order);
    Tracer::dump($order);
    $probe->dump($order);
    $quiet->dump($order);

    ob_start();
    var_dump($order);
    ob_start();
    @print_r($order);
    ob_start();
    $copy = $order;
    var_dump($copy);
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 15: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 16: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 19: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 20: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 21: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 23: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 24: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 25: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>
<li>line 34: Debug output call; remove it if it was left over from debugging.</li>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| configuration | list of strings | empty (see below) | Additional debug entries (`function_name` or `\Class::method`). |
| migratedIntoUserSpace | bool | false | When false, the built-in defaults are merged into `configuration`; when true, only `configuration` is used. |

Upstream persists the merged list into `configuration` once and flips
`migratedIntoUserSpace` to true; custos only needs the "effective list"
semantics above.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ForgottenDebugOutput": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "configuration": [],
        "migratedIntoUserSpace": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ForgottenDebugOutput

/**
 * @noinspection ForgottenDebugOutputInspection
 */
```
